newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 25.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast agrees exclusive exploration and production sharing with American oil company Santa Fe Energy Resources in off-shore Bloc-24
- China First Tractor and Construction Machinery Corp, through an Ivorian subsidiary, publishes an advertisement for its agricultural equipment, targeting rice and coffee growers.
- West and Central African agriculture ministers discuss closer cooperation to boost marketing within the region and research at meeting in Ivory Coast's commercial capital Abidjan.
